verdicts.quote: a component labeled "Grok Bot" can be dragged onto any Lightning app, home or record page; a page with it behaves exactly as the tab does.
no record of any other object (for example Account, Contact or Case) is read to build a request or changed by a reply.
They contain no user name, e-mail address, username, user Id, org Id, org name, and no field value of any Salesforce record.
A user who holds only a profile with no extra access plus the Grok Bot User permission set can do everything in U-1 to U-5 ... cannot open the admin tab
When user B tries to read, list, open, send in, retry in or delete user A's conversation or its messages by any route ... the answer is that it is not found or access is denied
forced by the platform rule that an HTTP callout cannot follow an uncommitted database write in the same transaction, so the message is stored before the call is made
verdicts.missing: Whether the callout runs in an asynchronous job (Queueable/future) or a synchronous request; C-127 implies a request held open for the timeout, and no async mechanism is named.

verdicts.quote: The administrator enters the xAI API key on the credential's page in Setup (no code, no deploy).
The ceiling is 120 because the platform allows no more than 120 seconds of callout time in a transaction.
verdicts.missing: Callouts per transaction, heap and CPU time limits are not named with their numbers (only callout time, DML rows, response size, concurrency are).

verdicts.quote: No test calls xAI; every call to Grok in a test is replaced by a stand-in response, and no test needs a key.
Every call is an HTTPS POST to `https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions` ... No other host or path is ever contacted by the bot.
verdicts.missing: That the host must be registered (Remote Site Setting or Named Credential URL) for the callout to be allowed is not stated.

verdicts.quote: When the reply or failure of a message in flight is stored, it appears in the open conversation within 10 seconds, with no reload by the user.
Once a message is stored as replied or as failed, a later arrival ... does not change it. No message ever has two replies.

When Salesforce refuses the request because too many long-running requests are active in the org at once, the message is stored as failed with category "Salesforce limit", the user is told to try again later
(4) Request rejected — any HTTP status that is not 2xx and not 401, 403, 408, 429 or 5xx ... (6) Provider error — HTTP 5xx; (7) Timed out
One send, or one Retry, produces at most one request to Grok, even after a timeout, 429 or 5xx.
the full received text is shown with a visible note that the answer was cut short; the message is not marked as failed.
its text; the time it was stored; its state (in flight, replied, failed); for a failed one, its failure category; for a Grok reply, the model it was generated by
every conversation whose latest message is more than "Retention days" days old is deleted with all its messages
The request body and headers sent to Grok contain only the system prompt, the conversation texts (C-14), and the model, temperature and maximum-output settings, plus the credential.
Setting "History window" is a whole number from 0 to 100, default 20 ... The value is N in C-14 and C-59.
a message of exactly 10,000 characters is sent and a message of exactly 1 character is sent.
The "Grok Bot Admin" tab offers settings: Enabled, Model, System prompt
Time; user; conversation (blank once the conversation is deleted); message (likewise); outcome
verdicts.missing: What was asked and answered is not retained in the audit once a user deletes the conversation; the log deliberately holds no text (C-97).

verdicts.quote: the credential is created again and its key entered in the target org, since a secret does not travel with a deploy
A message that has been in flight for longer than the configured timeout plus 30 seconds (so at most 150 seconds; with the default of 60, 90 seconds) is shown as failed
Whenever the panel is shown, in every state (empty, populated, failed, disabled), it displays a notice
No existing object, field, page layout, profile, permission set, app, flow, Apex class, sharing setting or org-wide default is altered or removed.
